subject: executor: fix hash join v2 bug that mistakenly think the join has other condition (#56834)
summary: Reviewed the single-file diff in `pkg/executor/builder.go` (buildHashJoinV2): it normalizes empty condition slices (`OtherConditions`/`LeftConditions`/`RightConditions`) to `nil` before wiring into HashJoinV2Exec (builder.go:1517+). This matches HashJoinV2 runtime checks that branch on `!= nil` (e.g. `HashJoinCtxV2.hasOtherCondition()` in `pkg/executor/join/base_join_probe.go:50`) and prevents falsely taking “has other/probe/build filter” code paths when the planner provides non-nil empty slices. No plausible Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, concurrency, or session/txn behavior issues found in this change.
